Title: Generally Available: Neon Serverless Postgres – an Azure Native Integration

Body.Content:
Neon Serverless Postgres – an Azure Native Integration is now generally available. Neon Serverless Postgres offers a modern, serverless, and fully managed Postgres service. Developed through collaboration between Microsoft and Neon, this integration simplifies the management of Neon resources by enabling seamless provisioning within the Azure portal and unified billing on existing Azure invoices. It also enhances security with single sign-on (SSO) using Microsoft credentials and improves the developer experience—you can use Azure CLI and SDKs across multiple programming languages to manage your resources. 

 

You can purchase this solution through the Azure portal or Azure Marketplace, receive a unified bill for all the services you use on Azure, and use your existing Enterprise Agreements.  

 Learn more.
